proposed_fixes.title: Probe omitted continuous VCP capabilities in maximum compatibility mode
proposed_fixes.root_cause: A parseable capabilities string lacking 0x62 can prevent direct probing: FetchCapabilitiesWithFallbackAsync probes only when parsed capabilities are null, while volume support is derived from the reconciled codes.
plan: Reproduce with a parseable capabilities string omitting 0x62 and a successful direct volume read; contrast normal and maximum compatibility modes.
Define a bounded read-only probe for missing supported continuous codes in maximum compatibility mode while preserving advertised metadata, cancellation, retry policy and invalid-handle handling.
Enable volume only after valid positive evidence; preserve the observed range and reuse the probed value. Do not simply force-enable a settings flag.
Add tests for parseable-but-incomplete capabilities, unsupported/zero-range replies, cache supplementation, cancellation and unavailable handles.

confidence.rationale: The reported direct-read result and current source gate align, but the affected release and hardware path have not been independently reproduced.

verification: Use a fake DDC transport for parsed capabilities without 0x62 plus a valid current=50/max=100 reply; maximum compatibility should discover volume without requiring corrupted settings.
On an M32U over DisplayPort, verify volume UI and CLI set/read, restart/rescan, normal-mode behavior and a monitor that genuinely rejects 0x62.

judgment.recommended_action: Run the focused maintainer reproduction before choosing an implementation.
evidence: The report supplies the complete capability string, CLI diagnostic, hardware/connection and a successful direct Windows VCP read returning 50/100.
Twinkle Tray volume control reportedly works; editing cached settings is overwritten on rediscovery.

issue_context.summary: Power Display may skip a supported volume code when capabilities parse successfully but omit 0x62.
known_information: The report supplies the complete capability string, CLI diagnostic, hardware/connection and a successful direct Windows VCP read returning 50/100.
Twinkle Tray volume control reportedly works; editing cached settings is overwritten on rediscovery.

setup: Retain a parseable capabilities string that omits VCP 0x62 and a direct read returning current=50, maximum=100.
Record normal/maximum compatibility mode and exclude another monitor application from concurrent bus access.
reproduce.expected_result: Maximum compatibility admits omitted volume only on valid positive evidence and reuses the measured range; failures do not expose an unsupported control or discard unrelated advertised capabilities.
reproduce.version_requirement: Reported 0.102.3001.0; compare an exact current build
steps: 1. Start discovery in normal mode and record advertised volume support.
2. Enable maximum compatibility mode, rescan, and check whether 0x62 is actually probed.
3. Compare a successful direct read with the per-monitor Volume control and CLI volume support.
4. Repeat with an unsupported or invalid-range reply, cancellation and a disconnected monitor.
prerequisites: Gigabyte M32U with DDC/CI enabled over DisplayPort, or a fake DDC transport returning the supplied capability string.
